doc.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013

title: Pay for early gigs
summary: Fifteen dollars a night compared to secretarial wages.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What did you usually make on a — I’m just curious about the pay musicians got and how, if you lined it up with what people were making for an hourly wage, and the cost of living and that whole thing. What was an average gig paying for you?

Well when I started singing an average gig was like about 15 dollars a night at the local venues. And I’m very vague about how that added up in that time. But I can remember making 15 dollars a night. And I think that wasn’t too bad because I think a full time job was paying something like 20, 25 dollars a week, say for a secretary.
So 15 a night wasn’t too bad.
It wasn’t too bad. You worked two nights on the weekend, that was 30 dollars.
